issue: Blocked task cannot be edited at all; description and priority are not modifiable
actual: For blocked tasks ("Complete tax filing", "Submit final report", "QA Full Task") the edit button has disabled=true, so no edit dialog can be opened. Clicking the card/title also opens no dialog (document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog]').length === 0). There is no way to change the blocked task's description or priority, whereas the spec requires those two fields to remain editable while title and deadline are locked.

evidence: Blocked tasks show an amber prerequisite warning row and their complete (circle) button has disabled=true; unblocked tasks have it enabled.

Single incomplete prereq: 'Prerequisite "Review project proposal" incomplete' (Complete tax filing) and 'Prerequisite "Buy groceries" incomplete' (QA Full Task). Multiple: "2 prerequisites incomplete" (Submit final report).

Hovering the warning badge shows a tooltip: single-prereq case -> "Dependency Chain / Review project proposal / pending"; multi-prereq case (Submit final report) -> "Dependency Chain / Review project proposal pending / Complete tax filing pending".

Dashed SVG connectors (stroke-dasharray 6px,4px) are Radix tooltip triggers. Hovering one opens tooltip "Dependency Chain / Complete tax filing pending / Review project proposal pending" (data-state -> delayed-open).

Chain QA Edited Task -> QA Full Task -> Buy groceries. Editing "Buy groceries" offers only: Review project proposal, Schedule dentist appointment, Complete tax filing, Organize desk, Reply to client emails, Submit final report — itself, direct dependent (QA Full Task) and indirect dependent (QA Edited Task) are omitted. Editing "Review project proposal" likewise omitted its dependents Complete tax filing and Submit final report.

Assigned "QA Full Task" as prerequisite of "QA NoDeadline Task" via edit; saved card shows 'Prerequisite "QA Full Task" incomplete'. Also "Submit final report" holds 2 prerequisites and displays "2 prerequisites incomplete".

Edited unblocked task: title QA NoDeadline Task->"QA Edited Task", description->"Edited description", deadline->Sep 20, priority Medium->Low, prerequisite->QA Full Task; all retained after Save Changes. Deleted "Schedule dentist appointment": removed from list, active count 7->6.
Active tab (badge 6) lists only the 6 incomplete tasks; Completed tab (badge 2) lists only "Reply to client emails" and "Organize desk". Header "6 active, 2 completed" matches both badges.

Every card shows title + priority badge (e.g. "Buy groceries / Low"). Description and deadline render only when supplied ("Organize desk / Low" has neither; "QA Full Task / High / QA description text / Sep 5"). Blocked cards add the amber prerequisite warning. Completed tasks render with line-through + text-muted-foreground.
Completed "Buy groceries": it disappeared from Active list, appears in Completed list; counts moved from "6 active, 2 completed" to "5 active, 3 completed" (tab badges Active 5 / Completed 3).

"QA Full Task" complete button disabled=true while prereq "Buy groceries" incomplete. After completing "Buy groceries", its complete button became disabled=false and the card label changed to "1 prerequisite completed". Still-blocked tasks (Submit final report, Complete tax filing, QA Edited Task) remain disabled=true.

"Buy groceries" stayed in the Completed view with all data intact ("Buy groceries / Low / Milk, eggs, bread... / Tomorrow"). Reopening "Organize desk" from the completed view moved it back to Active (counts 5a/3c -> 6a/2c), confirming completed tasks persist until reopened or deleted.

issue: Reopening a prerequisite leaves the dependent task simultaneously completed and blocked
actual: Setup: "Buy groceries" completed, then dependent "QA Full Task" completed (counts 4 active, 4 completed state). Reopening "Buy groceries" from the Completed view was allowed with no warning, confirmation or toast. Result: counts "6 active, 2 completed"; the Completed view still lists "QA Full Task" and its card now reads 'QA Full Task | High | QA description text | Sep 5 | Prerequisite "Buy groceries" incomplete' — it is completed and blocked at the same time. The system neither prevented the reopen nor returned the dependent to an incomplete state.
